## Objective
- Build a complete, playable low-quality 3D shooter with zombie wave and prop hunt modes, AK-47s, RPGs, and ragdoll-on-kill visuals.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using Canvas raycasting and procedural pixel-style art, with no external game engine.
- Included desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a menu with selectable Undead Waves and Prop Hunt modes, HUD, pause/end screens, and responsive styling.
- Implemented raycast environment, movement, shooting/reloading, AK-47 and RPG-7, enemy AI, health, waves, prop disguises, and kill ragdolls.
- Verified `game.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/inspected `screenshots/dead-air-menu.jpg` and `screenshots/dead-air-game.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate the latest changes and gameplay, especially the first wave’s enemy placement and Prop Hunt behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing after the most recent `nextWave()` change; test both modes, weapon switching, and ragdoll behavior.
2. Fix any issues found and recheck with a single latest JPEG screenshot.
3. Summarize the delivered game and controls to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and HUD markup.
- `style.css`: Menu, HUD, and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic, raycasting renderer, controls, enemies, weapons, modes, and ragdolls.
- `screenshots/dead-air-game.jpg`: Latest gameplay visual check before the final code adjustment.

## Important Context
- The repository changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `playwright-cli`’s default `open` failed because the configured Playwright Chromium was missing; opening with `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/.bin/playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002 --config /tmp/opencode/pw.json` succeeded using system Chromium at `/usr/bin/chromium`.
- The last code edit made `nextWave()` spawn a zombie near the player in wave one to make initial combat reliably visible; this edit has not yet been browser-verified.
